title: Mediterranean Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and quick stir fry packed with Mediterranean ingredients.

ingredients.name: Mediterranean Stir Fry Mix
ingredients.notes: Pre-made mix from the grocery store

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Mediterranean stir fry mix and cook according to package instructions.
Add the juicy tomatoes and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, until they start to break down.
Stir in the crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
